meta.title: 네온 하이웨이 1986
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from source/BRIEF.md (네온 하이웨이 1986, a retro arcade racing game (fictional game)). Every decision below follows the brief and the style it names; nothing is a preset.

source.notes: 네온 하이웨이 1986, a retro arcade racing game (fictional game)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Outrun at night: a violet sky #0E0420 to #2D0B4E burning pink #FF4F9A at the horizon, a sun from yellow #FFE45C to magenta #FF2E88, a magenta grid #FF3CC8, cyan neon #3CF0FF, a red car #E8203C; chrome is a sky-to-ground gradient with a dark horizon line.
rationale.type: Gugi, a heavy rounded display face, for the chrome title and the neon lines; Orbit, a geometric face, for the speed, the OSD and the small print.
rationale.motion: Speed and tape: the grid and the road dashes rush at the camera in perspective, palms flick past, the car banks; the title slams down with a shake and a sheen; neon flickers; a VHS tracking band tears the picture sideways, the tape tears hard as the rival passes, and the reel ends with the CRT folding to a line.
rationale.sound: A new synthwave preset at 96 BPM in A minor: a detuned poly pad, a running saw bass on eighths, bright sixteenth saw arpeggios, offbeat stabs, a saw lead, kick on every beat and a gated-reverb snare on two and four, toms for fills; whooshes for the passes, an impact for the title, a glitch for the tear.
rationale.visuals: All code: a sun clipped into bands that thicken toward the horizon, wireframe mountains, a perspective grid whose rows scroll by 1/z, a road with dashes, palm silhouettes scaled by depth, a car drawn from behind, chrome and neon type, a VHS pass (a ghost, a tracking band and tears copied sideways from the frame, scanlines, PLAY and a counter).
rationale.narration: Not recommended: the engine is the voice.
